question_text: Juan is a witness to a murder and has received death threats. He applies for admission to the Witness Protection Program (WPP) under RA 6981. Which of the following is a benefit that Juan can expect if he is admitted?

options.text: Automatic relocation to any country of his choice.
A monthly allowance equivalent to his previous salary for life.
Security protection, including possible relocation and change of identity.
Immunity from all criminal charges, including those unrelated to the case.
